newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian official says Malaysia "paid" for Games.
newsitem.headline: Australian official says Malaysia "paid" for Games.

text.p: A leading Australian sports official said Malaysia had won the right to host the 1998 Commonwealth Games through "the power of money", Australian media reported on Saturday.

Controversial Australian Commonwealth Games official Arthur Tunstall reportedly told a sports gathering in South Australia state on Thursday that Adelaide, which unsuccessfully bid against Kuala Lumpur, could not match "what was being bought".
"It was unfortunate the power of money and other influences won the day," Saturday's Sydney Morning Herald quoted Tunstall as saying.
